answer: Before entering the meadow of open work, every agent posts a 60 POA bond. A beacon draws a random 5% sample each epoch; each sampled agent must answer a compute heartbeat in one minute, proving live work. Three peers re-run the check; failure burns the bond and flags the grove of accounts sharing its referral links. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 60 once and earns it back after 20 clean epochs.
